email_body:
Dear Fanfinity team,

I'm applying for the Junior Airtable Developer role. Your focus on building scalable internal systems for gaming communities immediately caught my attention.

In my current work, I build and optimize websites and automate repetitive tasks using Python, JavaScript, and AI tools. I've designed structured data and workflows that improve search visibility and user experience, and I regularly translate business needs into technical solutions. While my direct Airtable experience is limited, I have a solid foundation in relational databases from my computer science coursework and have worked with low-code platforms like WordPress and Shopify. I'm eager to apply my problem-solving skills to Airtable and grow within your team.

I'm fluent in English and have a keen eye for UX/UI, which I've applied to create intuitive interfaces. I'm excited about the opportunity to contribute to Fanfinity's international environment and learn from your Senior Developer.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can support your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in the Junior Airtable Developer position at Fanfinity. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I have always been drawn to roles that combine problem-solving with building efficient systems. Fanfinity's mission to connect brands and communities through gaming resonates with me, and I am eager to contribute to your internal tools while developing my skills under the guidance of your Senior Developer.

In my freelance work, I design and build websites using WordPress and Elementor, where I automate processes with Python and JavaScript to streamline repetitive tasks. For example, I implemented structured data and JSON-LD schema to improve search visibility, and I created a free site-check enquiry flow that enhanced user experience. My experience with relational databases comes from my computer science coursework at Karel de Grote Hogeschool and Celal Bayar University, where I studied database architecture and data modeling principles. While I have not yet worked directly with Airtable, I have used low-code platforms like Shopify and WordPress to manage content and workflows, and I am confident in my ability to quickly learn Airtable's ecosystem.

I bring a strong analytical mindset and a keen eye for UX/UI, as demonstrated in my work on mirook.com, where I optimized the site's structure and implemented accessible markup. I am proactive in suggesting improvements and have a track record of taking ownership of projects, such as building a consistent layout for ~600 member profile pages for a pharmacists' association. I am fluent in English and have good communication skills in Dutch, which I am continuing to improve.

I am excited about the opportunity to work in a fast-growing international environment like Fanfinity, where I can contribute to scalable business solutions and learn from a passionate team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Technical background with coursework in computer science and relational databases, providing a solid foundation for Airtable development.
• Experience with low-code platforms (WordPress, Shopify) and automation using Python and JavaScript, demonstrating ability to learn new tools quickly.
• Strong problem-solving skills and analytical mindset, applied to SEO and web optimization projects.
• Keen eye for UX/UI, with hands-on experience creating user-friendly interfaces and accessible markup.
• Fluent in English and improving Dutch, with good communication skills for collaborating in an international team.
